returning: detail: expected to return after missing two games with a lower-body injury
away.summary: The Blues (7-7-1) are projected to have Colton Parayko return to the lineup after missing two games with a lower-body injury. Jordan Binnington is projected to start, his first game since a 2-0 loss to the Montreal Canadiens on Oct. 27. Jonatan Berggren and Theo Lindstein are listed as scratched.

home.summary: The Devils (10-5-0) are projected to start Connor Hellebuyck for the third straight game. Brenden Dillon is listed as a healthy scratch, and the team has no players listed as injured.
